text:
Rhea Kapoor: Quick flag  bulk tenant-import jobs are timing out for a small segment of customers using the CSV pipeline. Were seeing partial writes where some objects never made it to the index store. Engineers traced it to a retry deadlock in the writer queue after the persistence layer upgrade last night. Need a crisp customer note and a plan for renewal-risk accounts.

Liam O'Connor: How many tenants and which ones are in the renewal window?

Rhea Kapoor: 10 tenants affected; 3 are on renewal watch (within 45 days). Impact: 20-80% of rows in recent imports failed to commit, depending on size. We can re-run failed imports from existing job payloads once the writer is rolled back. Estimated mitigation ETA 2-4 hours; partial replay for small imports in ~30-60m.

Zoe Tan: For CS ops: recommend (1) a short proactive note to all affected tenants, (2) a prioritized remediation offer for the 3 renewal-risk accounts (assisted re-import + post-check), (3) AE one-pager with suggested credit wording and a quick approval flow. Tone should be technical but reassuring.

Marco Diaz: Suggest offering a one-off assisted re-import and a free data-integrity audit for renewal accounts. Also propose a dedicated office hours slot tomorrow for any customers who want live troubleshooting.

Jules Martin (Legal): Initial outreach should avoid committing to specific credits or service-level changes. Use compliance-safe wording: "We will evaluate eligibility for service or goodwill credits consistent with your agreement; your account team will follow up to confirm." For the assisted re-import, frame as an operational remediation offer subject to standard terms.

Rhea Kapoor: Draft short customer note below. Keeping it concise for engineering teams receiving this. Please review.

```
Subject: Notice: partial failures for recent tenant import jobs

Hi [Customer name],

We detected partial failures affecting recent tenant-import (CSV) jobs, which may have caused some rows to not be committed to your index. Our engineers identified a retry deadlock introduced in a persistence layer change last night and are rolling back the change now. We expect to restore normal import behavior within ~2-4 hours and will prioritize replays of failed imports.

What we're doing:
- Rolling back the persistence change to resolve the writer deadlock.
- Scheduling assisted re-imports for affected jobs and prioritizing any small imports first.
- Offering a complimentary data-integrity audit for impacted imports and priority support for customers with upcoming renewals.

Next steps: your CS lead will follow up with an account-specific update and to schedule any assisted re-imports. We will also evaluate eligibility for credits consistent with your agreement and confirm any offer in the follow-up. Track the incident: <status.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-4201>.

We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

- Rhea, Customer Success
```

Liam O'Connor: LGTM. For the renewal cohort add one line: "If you'd like immediate assistance, reply with preferred times and we'll schedule a dedicated remediation session within 24 hours."

Zoe Tan: I'll build the AE one-pager with the impacted job IDs, sample failed row counts, and suggested credit phrasing + the quick exec-approval checklist. Also adding a short feedback form link to capture whether customers want the assisted re-import or decline.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4201 created (priority: high). Postmortem meeting scheduled tomorrow 9:00 AM PT.

Marco Diaz: I'll own the office hours slot and the assisted re-import runbook with eng. Zoe  can you share the job lists so we can prioritize small imports first?

Zoe Tan: Sending job lists and a CS tracker update now. Also flagging the 3 renewal accounts so AEs can reach out directly after legal ack.

Jules Martin (Legal): Approved the language. Keep the public note at high level; save specifics (credit amounts, extended retention, etc.) for 1:1s.

Rhea Kapoor: Thanks everyone  sending the short note after legal ack and updating the CS tracker. :white_check_mark:
